scenarios.name: Path-scoped stageFile
notes: A direct stageFile call recorded a git_index event before staging src/app.js.
A second call targeting api/auth/signup.ts was denied before the index changed.

scenarios.name: Patch hunk stage
notes: A real unified diff hunk was applied to the index only after CodeSiteFS recorded a path-scoped git_index allowance.

scenarios.name: Forged stageLines target
notes: The request claimed src/app.js, but the unified diff header targeted api/auth/signup.ts. The service denied the actual patch target before git apply --cached.

scenarios.name: Same-route patch mismatch
notes: A patch targeting src/other.js was inside the write set, but the request claimed src/app.js. The boundary allowed the real path, then the service rejected the mismatch before git apply --cached.

scenarios.name: Unstage file pathspec
notes: A branch named src/app.js existed. unstageFile stayed on main and unstaged the file path using an explicit pathspec separator.
A denied unstageFile request outside clearance left the cached entry intact.

scenarios.name: Unstage hunk gate
notes: An approved staged hunk was removed from the index while the worktree edit remained.
A forged unstageLines patch targeting api/auth/signup.ts was denied before cached content changed.

scenarios.name: Repo-wide stageAll gate
notes: A path-scoped lease cannot stage the whole repository. The same direct service call succeeds only after ** git_index clearance.

scenarios.name: Repo-wide unstageAll gate
notes: A direct unstageAll call is blocked under path-scoped clearance and succeeds only after a broad git_index write set is granted.

assertions.name: stageFile records git_index before staging an allowed path
stageFile denial preserves the index for paths outside clearance
stageLines stages approved hunks only after git_index clearance
stageLines gates the patch header target instead of the claimed filePath
stageLines rejects same-route patch/filePath mismatches before applying
unstageFile uses pathspec disambiguation when a branch shares the file name
unstageFile denial preserves cached entries outside clearance
unstageLines removes approved hunks from index and keeps worktree edits
unstageLines forged patch denial preserves the cached target
stageAll is denied without broad index clearance and leaves the index untouched
stageAll with broad clearance stages every changed path
unstageAll is denied without broad index clearance and keeps staged entries
unstageAll with broad clearance moves all staged entries back to the worktree
